items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: No, other than I know that a lot of Benny's records in thirty three and thirty four, they just put all sorts of pseudonyms on them.

ctx.x: It was under the name of Harry Rosenthal which I suspect was Benny Goodman. Although I don't know. Does it mean anything to you Ed?
No, other than I know that a lot of Benny's records in thirty three and thirty four, they just put all sorts of pseudonyms on them.

items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Benny Goodman, Jimmy McPartland, Glenn Miller, do you remember playing with them? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about Benny Goodman and Jimmy McPartland. Benny Goodman?
Do you remember playing with him?
